values.value: Use when a provider contacts us after scheduling or planning a patient treatment to confirm product availability, treatment protocol, and documentation requirements before the appointment.

Dear [Contact.FirstName],
Thank you for contacting Allergan Moxie Provider Services regarding the upcoming treatment for Case #[Case.CaseNumber] at [Account.Name].
We are pleased to confirm that the requested products are available and your account is in good standing to proceed.
To ensure a smooth treatment experience, please review the following before the appointment:
1. Confirm the treating provider holds a current, active medical license and is listed on your Allergan Moxie credentialing record. 2. Ensure the patient has completed and signed the Allergan Moxie Patient Consent Form (Form AM-PC-005) prior to treatment. 3. Verify the product lot numbers and expiry dates are recorded in the patient file at time of administration (required per Form AM-TR-001, Treatment Record). 4. Any adverse events or unexpected reactions must be reported within 24 hours using the Adverse Event Reporting Form (Form AM-AE-003).
If you require additional product units or a dosage consultation prior to the appointment, please reply to this email at least 48 hours before the scheduled treatment date.
We look forward to supporting your patient care at [Account.Name].
Warm regards, [User.FirstName] [User.LastName] Provider Services Representative Allergan Moxie
